description.content:
Publishes a BigQuery bucket as an Analytics Hub listing and grants the supplied IAM principals subscriber access. Runs as an async job — the endpoint returns 202 with the job detail.

Initial response returns job details [JobResponse](#model-JobResponse). The result of the asynchronous job can be fetched via `/v2/storage/jobs/{id}`. When the job completes, final result is [BucketListingCreateJobResult](#model-BucketListingCreateJobResult).

 Parameters of job will be [BucketListingCreateJobParams](#components-schemas-BucketListingCreateJobParams).

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the bucket to publish as a listing.

response.name: Job accepted; returns job details.

Same gate is enforced on PATCH and DELETE for the same route.

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the bucket to publish as a listing.

description.content:
Initiate removal of the listing for the specified storage bucket. The listing is removed from the Analytics Hub exchange and the listing record is deleted. The underlying exchange is retained so that subsequent listings in the same project can reuse it.

Initial response returns job details [JobResponse](#model-JobResponse). The result of the asynchronous job can be fetched via `/v2/storage/jobs/{id}`. When the job completes, final result is [BucketListingDeleteResponse](#model-BucketListingDeleteResponse).

 Parameters of job will be [BucketListingDeleteJobParams](#components-schemas-BucketListingDeleteJobParams).

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the bucket whose listing should be removed.

response.name: Job accepted; returns job details.

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the bucket whose listing should be removed.

response.name: The token does not have MANAGE privilege on the bucket, or it is not an admin-attached token whose admin belongs to the bucket's organization (or holds the share role on the project), or the project lacks the bucket-exposure feature flag. Same gate is enforced on POST and PATCH for the same route.

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the bucket whose listing should be removed.

response.name: Returned when the bucket or its listing is not found.

variable.description: (Required) Identifier of the bucket whose listing should be removed.

description.content:
Update metadata and/or subscribers of an existing bucket listing. Only provided fields are updated, but the request body must include at least one of `exposureName`, `exposureDescription`, or `bigquery.subscribers` — an empty JSON object is rejected with 400. The `bigquery.listingId` is immutable and cannot be changed.

Initial response returns job details [JobResponse](#model-JobResponse). The result of the asynchronous job can be fetched via `/v2/storage/jobs/{id}`. When the job completes, final result is [BucketListingUpdateJobResponse](#model-BucketListingUpdateJobResponse).

 Parameters of job will be [BucketListingUpdateJobParams](#components-schemas-BucketListingUpdateJobParams).
